$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0. The built-in connector ELEMENT templates (M-067, M-068, M-072), in palette order. Read by org.sangam.modeller.template.ConnectorTemplates; templates are data (ADR-D-20, SL-104), so a template for a named external system is added here, never in product Java. Each document: id, name, description, appliesTo, fields (name, binding, required, then pattern, default and choices when set). A change of name, description, appliesTo or fields publishes a new template version at the next start.

templates.name: AWS Lambda function
templates.description: Invokes a Lambda function through the HTTP connector (auth.type=aws-sigv4, service lambda). Path /2015-03-31/functions/{function}/invocations; header X-Amz-Invocation-Type selects RequestResponse or Event. A function error (X-Amz-Function-Error) is a business failure FUNCTION_ERROR when response.failure-header is set.

templates.name: Azure Function (HTTP trigger)
templates.description: Calls an HTTP-triggered Azure Function through the HTTP connector (auth.type=function-key; the key is a secret:// reference in the connector configuration).

templates.name: Google Cloud Run / Cloud Functions
templates.description: Calls a Cloud Run service or a 2nd-gen function through the HTTP connector (auth.type=gcp-id-token; the audience is the service URL).

templates.name: Serverless function, asynchronous
templates.description: Starts a function and continues on its callback: the connector adds the callback (endpoint.callback.url, a /events/{channel} inbound webhook) and the correlation key (the operation id) to the request. Model a message catch event after this task correlated on the correlation key.

templates.name: DigiLocker: verify adult / pull document
templates.description: Pull with consent from DigiLocker. verify-adult answers identifiable, adult, issuer and a token reference (never the date of birth); pull lists the issued documents and fetches those named in uris.The consent code and PKCE verifier come from the consent step of the case.

templates.name: API operation (contract reference)
templates.description: Calls an operation of an OpenAPI or AsyncAPI document stored in the package: sangam:operationRef names it as contractId#operationId; the request body is validated against the operation schema.
